title: Tech Note: 4D Splash Screen
author: Thomas Fitch, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: XML preferences file (demoinfo.xml) read/written via DOM XML commands
SET COLOR / GOTO PAGE / SET TIMER classic form commands
New Process for displaying a modal splash screen window

historical_commentary.text: This note shows a classic-era pattern: a compiled component database, distributed and installed by dropping a .4dbase file into a binary-structure database's Components folder, configured via DOM XML commands writing to an XML preferences file. The underlying idea of a custom startup splash screen remains relevant, but the specific implementation is tied to Design Mode's binary component architecture, which was superseded by Project Mode's text-based, git-friendly structure (4D v17+, 2018), and to the legacy 4D DOM XML API alongside SET COLOR-style numeric color constants that have long been supplanted by richer object/CSS-based styling. Modern 4D projects would typically implement this with a project method, JSON preferences, and a plain form/window rather than a shipped compiled component.
related_updates: Project mode (4D v17+, 2018) replaced binary .4DBase/.4DProject component packaging with text-based, version-controllable components
JSON (via JSON commands / classes) is now the preferred settings-storage format over hand-built DOM XML trees
Modern 4D form/window and object styling (CSS-based) supersedes numeric SET COLOR constants
